java001.chunk: Java is an object-oriented programming language. Object-Oriented Programming has four principles: 1. Encapsulation 2. Inheritance 3. Polymorphism 4. Abstraction Polymorphism allows one interface to have multiple implementations. Example: Animal animal = new Dog(); animal.sound(); Inheritance allows one class to inherit another class. Java supports packages, interfaces and exception handling.
